illustrations.prompt: ONE standalone ultrawide 2.39:1 cinematic historical film frame, authentic early seventeenth century Fujian maritime battle in 1629. A few defending Chinese sailors in coarse indigo and grey short jackets brace long bamboo spears and a boat hook across the boarding gap, an attacking coastal raider wearing a simple blue wrap and carrying a Japanese sword is halted on the far end of a narrow plank, no caricature and no elaborate samurai fantasy armor. Restrained slate-blue and old ochre palette, sea mist and rain, natural backlighting on sailcloth and wet faces, soft halation, subtle grain, late twentieth century historical cinema nostalgia, clean composition two readable action clusters, one focal cut rope, no clutter, no text. It must feel a dangerous struggle between heavy moving ships, not a theatrical duel on land.
